name: vlmkit
description: Deterministic frontend quality gates as one automatic agent skill: verify markup, build it from a screenshot or generate Playwright tests.

plugins.name: vlmkit
plugins.description: Automatic frontend quality router. Describe the outcome — implement this mock, check this page, audit its design and colour, check a Flutter or Android app's accessibility, turn these criteria into tests — and it picks one of 13 bundled workflows and runs its deterministic gates to green. No API key: the gates are Playwright + pixel math, and the agent's own vision is the only VLM.
